reason: A web UI enhancement that displays a compact animated pixel whale beside the DeepSeek Harness Web running status without changing prompts, tools, model requests, or host behavior.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 的运行状态旁显示一个随会话运行而出现的像素鲸鱼动画，提供轻量的界面视觉增强。
summaries.en: Adds a compact animated pixel whale beside the DeepSeek Harness Web running status as a lightweight visual interface enhancement.

capabilities: Adds an animated pixel-art whale to the web interface during active turns
Observes the current conversation status row to track running state
Uses a React portal and cleans up UI elements when the turn ends or plugin unloads
